rows: Promotion of educational and economic interests of SCs, STs, and weaker sections

items: Article 40 (Village Panchayats) is frequently tested in Polity sections of UPSC, SSC, and State PSC exams.
Do not confuse Article 47 (Prohibition of intoxicating drinks) with Article 48 (Prohibition of cow slaughter).
Article 46 specifically targets the educational and economic interests of SCs, STs, and weaker sections.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Gandhian principles in the Constitution strive to fulfill Mahatma Gandhi's vision of rural development and social reform.
Article 40 focuses on the organisation of village panchayats as units of self-government.
Article 43 advocates for the promotion of cottage industries in rural areas.
Article 46 protects and promotes the educational and economic interests of SCs, STs, and other weaker sections.
Articles 47 and 48 mandate public health and agricultural welfare through prohibitions on intoxicating drinks and cow slaughter.
